rationale: With only 13 minutes to close, RAPP is trading near the bottom of its range (9.2% from low) after a massive intraday sell-off from ~$29.91 open to $25.17, sitting well below VWAP ($26.11) and the 9-EMA ($25.34). The wide bid-ask spread (47.7 bps) and choppy last 5 candles showing no clear directional momentum make entry unattractive in either direction — a short risks a late-day squeeze toward VWAP while a long faces continued selling pressure with forced liquidation at close in 13 minutes. The risk/reward does not justify a position at this stage.
